content: अधिवस् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To inhabit, fix oneʼs abode or residence in, settle, dwell or reside in (with <ab>acc.</ab> of place); गिरिमधिवसेस्तत्र विश्रामहेतोः <ls>Me. 25</ls>; यानि प्रियासहचरश्चिरमध्यवात्सम् <ls>U. 3. 8</ls>; बाल्यात्परामिव दशां मदनोऽध्युवास <ls>R. 5. 63</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 61</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 79</ls>; <ls>Śi. 3. 59</ls>; <ls>Bk. 1. 3</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">5. 6</ls>; माऽधिवात्सीर्भुवम् <ls n="Bk.">8. 79</ls>. .²2 To settle, alight or perch on. .²3 (€2 <ab>Ā.</ab>) To put on (clothes) . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to stay overnight. .²2 To consecrate, set up (as an image).
